author: Reilly Mahon
title: Ribbon cut on Sergeant Bluff Light Project - NewsBreak
text:
By Reilly Mahon Maren Ewertz No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
SERGEANT BLUFF , Iowa ( KCAU ) — For more than five years, the thought of a landmark feature in Sergeant Bluff was just a dream, but on Wednesday, that dream became a reality.
“I think it’s important because it is something that will stay here for a long time, and it’s kind of a focal point, you know,” said Sherry McGill, President of the Sergeant Bluff Community Foundation. “A lot of people, we didn’t have like a trademark place in our town, so we thought it would be good to have something that people could say, ‘Well, this is where it is.’ And, it’s visible from Highway 75.”
Story continues below
Following the ribbon cutting, the lights were turned on for the first time.
The lights will be color-changing for awareness months and special events.
